# The Art of Clarity

Writing is thinking made visible. When we write clearly, we think clearly. And when we think clearly, we act decisively.

The best writers don't decorate ideas — they reveal them. Every sentence earns its place. Every paragraph builds toward something.

I've spent twenty years editing manuscripts, and the pattern is always the same: confusion on the page reflects confusion in the mind. Fix the thinking, and the writing follows.

## Three Principles

First, know your reader. Second, cut everything that doesn't serve them. Third, read your work aloud — the ear catches what the eye misses.

The goal isn't perfection. It's connection.
